name: get_objc_classes
description: Discover Objective-C class labels, optionally filtering by literal substring. Rows are coalesced only when exact selected-image pointer-fixup evidence proves that their own addresses bind the same imported class symbol, binding stream, raw library ordinal and resolved library, weak status, and addend. Rows without that evidence remain separate, with identity coverage reported as unknown, partial, or unsupported.

pattern.description: Literal text or regular expression used to filter matching results.
